archive.id: SHA256 canonical descriptor without archiveId; audit identity only, never replaces any original operation/device ID
archive.retention: No implicit expiry/truncation/eviction. Capacity/quota excess refuses entire archive.

source.privateIdentity: Validate original X25519 pair, never copy raw identity/privateKey. Archive only public installation context plus original identity SHA.
source.journals: Preserve exact raw v1 and v2 text including original operations, target, intent/body/fingerprint, unknown/reserved/applied/rejected receipts, pending/processing outcomes, cursor/batch/reset snapshot/gap and event IDs.
source.authority: Preserve exact existing retained-authorizations-v1 text under read-only alias; validate complete client/credential epoch/authorization fingerprint. Never put source auth under active P9 record name.
source.missingAuthority: Persist exact referenced-minus-retained fingerprints; never borrow current token/vault or claim query capability. Identity/credential absence does not create replacement authority.
source.empty: Validated unbound/empty installation with no retained authority still projects away all source installation records.

destination.originals: Validate and preserve its own exact identity/private key, both nonempty journals and retained authority. These remain original local records, not source-imported authority.
destination.archives: Merge existing and source archives by exact content ID, preserve payload bytes, reject divergence/orphans/capacity.
destination.existingClients: ExistingInstallation rejection for real clients/vault remains; this stage does not implement merging live profiles.
destination.uiDevicePolicy: Existing P7 source display preferences/OS receipts reset/archive policy remains. Parent must not let that reset trigger remote off/register actions.

activation.gate: Required for any source/destination archive or nonempty destination original. Exact storage root/candidate id/sha/count and owner quiescence checked before staging and before/after final external publication checkpoint. No writes on missing/stale lease.
activation.ownerContract: Parent disposes old notification workers/coordinator and gates automatic enrollment before minting lease; callback reads scalar state only, no UI/IO or commands. Hold boundary until atomic activation finishes. Retire old storage handles.
activation.newSession: On IO, read requiresExplicitSetup(freshStorage) before binding; gate new enrollment until completion. True for any read-only archive, or an actually published migration with nonempty retained local notification originals. Ordinary unmigrated local journals alone do not add a new setup requirement. Independent human action is needed for any new subscription; no automatic register/confirm/off/replay.
activation.originalQueries: Archive presence never proves runtime or credential validity. Only actual original installation keys, original saved authority, target and protocol permit any independently authorized read-only original query; no archived SavedConnection/Identity constructor.

readOnlyHook: IO only: NativeMigrationNotificationArchives.readOnlyArchives(storage); wrappers redact toString and expose exact Original enum audit text, never command objects.
atomicity: Existing unified export/candidate/prepared generation/pointer/count/hash/rollback/idempotency, no second migrator. Idempotent published receipt does not overwrite later target originals even without a new lease.
limits: Existing 8MiB text/JSON header budget unchanged; simultaneous near-maximum v1/v2/authority or merged history may exceed it and whole-archive refuse. Larger typed-original streaming is an open gate, not partial export.
Unknown/future/corrupt schemas, missing bound identity/journal, invalid credential epochs, target mismatch and incomplete atomic sidecars reject while preserving originals.
EasyWork authorization fence remains separate explicit unsupported whole-archive gap.
Parent actual entry disposal/rebind/enrollment gate and real device/DEV acceptance remain open. A6 stays paused.
